text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 1: Change in error from adding ERA5 variables, the ten planned contrasts'
text.tspan: Figure 1: Change in error from adding ERA5 variables, the ten planned

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS: satellite irradiance service. Dot: estimate. Thin line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Thick line: 99.5% interval, adjusted for the ten planned contrasts. Dashed rules: no difference, and the smallest improvement worth acting on (0.1 percentage points of capacity, or 0.01 clearness index). Each row is the error with the first variable set minus the error with the second. P4: G9 minus G9 without the MARS-only variables. Error: mean absolute error. A variable set is the list of inputs the XGBoost model is given. G0: sun position, ERA5 solar radiation, and air temperature. G1 adds total cloud cover, G2 adds low, mid, and high cloud cover, and G9 adds every other ERA5 variable studied. MARS-only: 12 ERA5 variables that ECMWF's MARS archive serves and that we did not find in its free open-data feed or in Open-Meteo's. Clearness index: irradiance divided by the irradiance at the top of the atmosphere. All rows are planned: written into the study plan before any result existed.'
